Multiple Indian organizations announce scholarships and internships

Several Indian organizations have opened applications for various scholarships and internships. The State Bank of India (SBI) Foundation announced a scholarship program for over 25,000 students, with applications open until September 4. SBI is also offering a Summer Internship program for students. The Airports Authority of India (AAI) is recruiting for 389 posts, with applications opening August 8. The Punjab State Council of Educational Research and Training has invited applications for national scholarships, with a deadline of August 31. The Abhay Bhutada Foundation awarded Rs 21 lakh in scholarships to 300 students.
